newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Petroceltic co-opts Dana chief onto board.
newsitem.headline: Petroceltic co-opts Dana chief onto board.

text.p: Irish exploration group Petroceltic Plc said on Thursday that Tom Cross, chief executive of Dana Petroleum Plc, had been co-opted to the board of the company.
Cross replaced Ray French as chairman, Petroceltic said in a statement.
Ray French, Hugh McCormack and Paul Power had resigned as directors of the company with immediate effect, it added.
Roy Askew, finance director of Dana, replaced Hugh McCormack as company secretary of Petroceltic, it said.

The moves follow a recent announcement by Dana that it had obtained acceptances in respect of its offer for all the issued share capital of Petroceltic representing 85.72% of the issued share capital of Petroceltic and that it was extending its offer for the remaining Petroceltic shares until further notice. -- Dublin Newsroom +353 1 676 9775
